list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "raw", tag: "run", start: 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z, predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor")

list.name: stream
list.label: Stream
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "raw", tag: "stream", start: 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z, predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor")

list.name: horizon
list.label: Horizon (s)
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "forecasts", tag: "horizon", start: 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z, predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "forecast")

panels.title: Data vs forecast
panels.description: 1 s mean of the raw stream against each model's forecast for the same instant, made `horizon` seconds earlier. Raw stream shows what crossed Skylink (gaps during outages, then backfill).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and r.run == "${run}" and r.stream == "${stream}" and r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > 1000000000 then v.windowPeriod else 1s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, model: "actual"}))
  |> group(columns: ["model"])

from(bucket: "forecasts") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forecast" and r.run == "${run}" and r.stream == "${stream}" and r.horizon == "${horizon}" and r.arm =~ /^${arm:regex}$/ and r.model =~ /^${model:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > 1000000000 then v.windowPeriod else 1s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, model: r.arm + "/" + r.model}))
  |> group(columns: ["model"])

panels.title: Skylink link state
panels.description: Seeded Markov on/off chain, stepped in event time.

panels.title: Ground-truth events (this stream)
panels.description: Sensor faults and process events injected by the simulator. t1_us is the end of the event.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "truth_event" and r.run == "${run}" and (r.stream == "${stream}") and (r.kind != "spike" and r.kind != "burst" and r.kind != "gust" and r.kind != "cloud"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "stream", "kind"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "stream", "kind", "mag", "t1_us", "id"]) |> group()

panels.title: Rolling error (MAE) by model
panels.description: Mean absolute error per window, prequential. Lower is better; persistence is the bar to beat.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "forecasts") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "error" and r._field == "abs_err" and r.run == "${run}" and r.stream == "${stream}" and r.horizon == "${horizon}" and r.arm =~ /^${arm:regex}$/ and r.model =~ /^${model:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > 60000000000 then v.windowPeriod else 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, model: r.arm + "/" + r.model}))
  |> group(columns: ["model"])

panels.title: MAE over the selected range, all horizons

targets.query:
from(bucket: "forecasts") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "error" and r._field == "abs_err" and r.run == "${run}" and r.stream == "${stream}" and r.arm =~ /^${arm:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["model", "horizon"]) |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._stop, _value: r._value, name: r.model + " h=" + r.horizon + "s"}))
  |> group(columns: ["name"])

panels.title: Late / backfilled data reaching the base
panels.description: Points that crossed Skylink late (more than 2 s behind the newest) and how far behind (s).

panels.title: River service resource use
panels.description: CPU percent of one core, RSS MB and p99 per-step latency (ms) of the river container's process.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "resource" and r.run == "${run}" and (r._field == "cpu_pct" or r._field == "rss_mb" or r._field == "step_ms_p99"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > 10000000000 then v.windowPeriod else 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "arm"])

panels.title: Agent decisions
panels.description: Agent proposals and guardrail verdicts (empty until the agent layer is on).
